successors.name: Mongol Empire
successors.text: the basins of the Selenga and the lower Orkhon: south Buryatia, Bulgan Province and Selenge Province

wars.name: Temüjin's wars with the Merkits
wars.outcome: Börte was kidnapped by Merkit raiders around 1181 and rescued within the year with Jamukha and Toghrul; 'From 1191 to 1207, Temujin fought the Merkits five times'; the Merkits were defeated in 1200 and their remnants crushed in 1215-1218.

certainty.note: A steppe confederation known by river basins; no border.
